texts.preamble: Kanhaiya Lal Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 July, 2019 Author: Rajiv Joshi Bench: Rajiv Joshi High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 72 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 27897 of 2019 Applicant :- Kanhaiya Lal Sharma Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar Dubey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Rajiv Joshi,J. 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State. 2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the N.B.W. dated 14.5.2019 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hathras in Criminal Case No. 771 of 2008 (State of U.P. Vs. Kanhaiya Lal Sharma), under Section-7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station- Hathras Gate, District- Hathras. 3. The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that no offence against the applicant is disclosed and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of causing harassment.
texts.arguments: 3. The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that no offence against the applicant is disclosed and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of causing harassment. He pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention. At this stage only prima facie case is to be seen in the light of the law laid down by Supreme Court in cases of R.P. Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, A.I.R. 1960 S.C. 866, State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cr.) 426, State of Bihar Vs. P.P.Sharma, 1992 SCC (Cr.) 192 and lastly Zandu Pharmaceutical Works Ltd. Vs. Mohd. Saraful Haq and another (Para-10) 2005 SCC (Cr.) 283. 5. 6. However, in view of the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that in case the applicant appears and surrenders before the court below within 30 days from today and applies for bail, his prayer for bail shall be considered and decided in view of the settled law laid by this Court in the case of Amrawati and another Vs. State of U.P. reported in 2004 (57) ALR 290 as well as judgement passed by Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2009 (3) ADJ 322 (SC) Lal Kamlendra Pratap Singh Vs. State of U.P. 7.
